ECE314H1 - Fundamentals of Electrical Energy Systems

Credit Value: 0.50
Hours: 36.6L/12.2T/18.3P

High-efficiency energy conversion via switched-mode power electronic circuits: design and steady-state modeling of DC/DC converters, DC/AC converters using pulse-width modulation.

Prerequisite: ECE212H1 and ECE221H1 and ECE231H1
Exclusion: ECE349H1
